david-olsson.name: David Olsson
david-olsson.title: David Olsson — Founder of Co-Ownership Property | 20+ Years in Alpine Real Estate
david-olsson.subtitle: Two decades selling premium ski properties across more than forty Alpine resorts before founding Co-Ownership Property in 2022 to make trophy second homes accessible again to clients who had been priced out of whole ownership.
david-olsson.metaDescription: David Olsson, founder of Co-Ownership Property. 20+ years selling premium second homes across the French Alps and 40+ Alpine resorts before founding COP in 2022. Specialist expertise in fractional co-ownership, European luxury real estate, French Alps property market, and cross-border ownership for non-residents.
expertiseAreas: Fractional co-ownership across European and US markets
French Alpine real estate (Courchevel, Val d'Isère, Méribel, Chamonix, Megève, La Plagne, Tignes, Les Arcs, La Rosière)
Mediterranean luxury second homes (Mallorca, Costa del Sol, Ibiza)
LLC and SCI structures for property holding
Resale dynamics in the fractional category
